name: Pueblo of Zia (United States)
description: A white field with a black border, charged at the centre with the red Zia sun symbol — a circle with four groups of four rays — beneath the words 'Pueblo of Zia' in black.
history: The Zia sun, the sacred symbol of Zia Pueblo, also appears on the flag of New Mexico; the four groups of rays stand for the four directions, seasons, times of day and stages of life.
